description: For rationals p and q, inclusion of their lower cuts is equivalent to p at most q, and proper inclusion is equivalent to p less than q.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower_order (p q : ℚ) :
  (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower p ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower q ↔ p ≤ q) ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower p ⊂ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower q ↔ p < q)
